name: audit the relmath to obsmetrologia rewrite for orphaned proven theorems
asks: The legacy archive holds 5,178 Lean files (relmath-lean: Sheaf, LinearLogicChu, LawvereLaplacianSpectralGap, TemporalTwoCategory, SettlingOverValueCategory, ...) against Obsmetrologia's 355 current files. Which proven results died in the rewrite without being re-seated? Orphaned proven theorems are exactly 'legacy misallocated resources' in the Union Recovery Service's mandate, applied to mathematical capital rather than files-in-the-wrong-settlement: proven work the firm paid real inference for, now stranded where no current apparatus cites or re-runs it. A bounded dossier comparing declaration inventories across the two generations would either recover real capital or witness that the rewrite lost nothing — an evidenced empty watch being valid here as everywhere. Only an instrument that can read both generations at once can do this.
